summary: Log where a request or the engine-core loop is held
details: A warning names the stage when a request spends more than VLLM_REQUEST_STALL_WARNING_S (default 60) outside engine work, or ends without output after that long; VLLM_LOG_REQUEST_TIMELINE=1 logs every request's stages.
The engine core warns about ADD requests that waited in its input queue and logs the loop stack when one step runs longer than the threshold.
SIGUSR1 to the API server logs every asyncio task's await chain and every thread's stack, without prompt or output text.
